description: Implementation of a helper class for constructing and caching Direct3D 9 vertex declarations within the ANGLE project, including methods for applying vertex attribute declarations, managing cache, and handling instancing.

classes.name: VertexDeclarationCache
classes.description: A class that manages caching and application of vertex declarations for Direct3D 9 rendering in ANGLE.

methods.name: applyDeclaration
methods.description: Constructs or retrieves a cached vertex declaration based on current vertex attributes and applies it to the device, handling instancing and stream sources.

methods.name: markStateDirty
methods.description: Resets internal cache state to force reapplication of vertex declarations and stream sources.
